tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Exam Command Words

questions.question: Q: What is the difference between describe and explain?
questions.correctAnswer: Describe tells what happens (the process or features); explain tells why it happens (the reasons or mechanisms).

questions.question: Q: How should you structure an answer to an evaluate question?
questions.correctAnswer: Identify strengths and weaknesses of each option, then make a clear, justified judgement about which is better and why.

questions.question: Q: What does a compare answer require that a describe answer does not?
questions.correctAnswer: A compare answer must identify BOTH similarities AND differences. A describe answer only states features without linking them.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on Exam Command Words

questions.question: Q: How should you approach a justify question?
questions.correctAnswer: State your choice clearly, then provide specific, technical reasons supporting it. Each reason should link a feature to a requirement.

questions.question: Q: What is the key difference between discuss and evaluate?
questions.correctAnswer: Discuss requires a balanced argument from multiple perspectives. Evaluate requires the same PLUS a clear, justified judgement.
